blocks.text: Elements ko families mein bhi baanta ja sakta hai. Element family aise elements ka set hai jin ki properties milti-julti hon. Periodic table mein elements ki mashhoor families yeh hain:

items: Alkali metals (Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs, Fr)
Alkaline earth metals (Be, Mg, Ca, Sr, Ba, Ra)
Transition metals (Sc, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn)
Halogens (F, Cl, Br, I, At, Ts)
Noble gases (He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, Rn, Og)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab “five” (paanch) families likhti hai lekin list mein chhe (6) families hain. Alkaline earth metals mein “(Be, Mg, Ca, Ba, R.)” chhapa hai: strontium (Sr) reh gaya hai aur “R.” se murad radium (Ra) hai. Sahi: Be, Mg, Ca, Sr, Ba, Ra.

Group 1 ke elements alkali metals kehlate hain kyun ke yeh pani se react kar ke alkalis (pani mein hal hone wale bases) banate hain. Sodium aur potassium is ki mashhoor misalein hain. In mein ek valence electron hota hai, density kam, melting point nisbatan kam aur ionization energy kam hoti hai. Yeh sab se zyada reactive metals hain.

Group 2 ke elements metals hain jo zyada tar zameen (earth) mein milte hain aur alkalis banate hain, is liye inhein alkaline earth metals kehte hain. Misal: calcium aur magnesium. In ke valence shell mein do electrons hote hain, is liye yeh divalent (do bond banane wale) hain. Yeh thos (solid) metals hain jo alkali metals se zyada sakht aur zyada dense hain. Yeh asani se oxidize ho jate hain aur heat aur bijli (electricity) achhi tarah guzarte hain.

Transition metals periodic table ke beech mein elements ki sab se bari family hain. In mein d-block elements ki chaar series aur neeche wali do rows ke lanthanides aur actinides (f-block elements) shamil hain. In ki thermal aur electrical conductivity zyada, melting point zyada, density zyada hoti hai, aur in ki oxidation states badalti rehti hain (variable oxidation states). Yeh aksar rangeen (coloured) compounds banate hain.

Group 16 ke elements Chalcogens kehlate hain kyun ke copper (Greek mein chalkos) ki zyada tar ores (khaam dhaat) oxides ya sulfides hoti hain. Is group mein oxygen aur sulfur non-metals hain, Se, Te aur Po ko kitab metalloids kehti hai, aur livermorium (Lv) metal hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “Rivernorium” chhapa hai. Aisa koi element nahi; sahi naam livermorium (Lv, element 116) hai, jo group 16 ke sab se neeche hai.

Group 17 ke elements halogens kehlate hain aur yeh non-metals hain. “Halogen” ka matlab hai “salt-former” (namak banane wala), kyun ke yeh alkali metals aur alkaline earth metals se asani se react kar ke mazboot (stable) halide salts banate hain. Misal: fluorine, chlorine, bromine. Halogens bohat reactive non-metals hain aur in ki electron affinity zyada hai. Yeh apna bahar wala shell poora karne ke liye asani se ek electron le lete hain.

Noble gases group 18 mein periodic table ke bilkul daen kinare par hain aur yeh react nahi kartin. Misal: helium aur argon. In ka bahar wala shell poora (complete) hota hai, is liye aam halaat mein yeh taqreeban bilkul react nahi kartin aur doosre elements se bohat kam compounds banati hain. Yeh monoatomic hain, yani akele atom ki shakal mein rehti hain.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Noble gases react nahi kartin, phir bhi in ke kuch compounds bante hain. Misal: xenon ke compounds, jaise xenon hexafluoroplatinate (XePtF₆). Isi liye “inert gases” (bilkul react na karne wali gases) ka naam badal kar “noble gases” rakha gaya.

blocks.prompt: a) Groups 1 aur 2 ke elements s-block elements kyun kehlate hain?
blocks.explanation: Groups 1 aur 2 ke valence electrons s subshell mein hote hain: group 1 mein ek (ns¹) aur group 2 mein do (ns²). Jis subshell mein aakhri electron jaye, block wahi hota hai, is liye yeh s-block hain.

blocks.prompt: b) Chalcogen family ke elements ke naam batayein aur un ki do khasoosiyaat (characteristics) likhein.
blocks.explanation: Chalcogens group 16 ke elements hain: O, S, Se, Te, Po (aur Lv). Do khasoosiyaat: (1) in ke valence shell mein chhe electrons (ns² np⁴) hote hain; (2) copper ki zyada tar ores in ke oxides ya sulfides hain, isi liye naam Greek chalkos (copper) se hai. Group mein neeche non-metal se metal ki taraf kirdar badalta hai.

items: Chhe families: alkali metals (group 1), alkaline earth metals (group 2), transition metals (d aur f block), chalcogens (group 16), halogens (group 17) aur noble gases (group 18).
Group 1 sab se reactive metals; halogens salt-formers; noble gases ke shell poore, magar xenon ke kuch compounds bante hain.
